title: TanStack Query (React Query)
description: Powerful data synchronization for React — fetching, caching, and updating server state.

data.text: TanStack Query (formerly React Query) is a data-fetching library that handles caching, background refetching, deduplication, and window focus refetching out of the box. It treats server state as a first-class concern.

data.title: Basic Query
data.content: Fetch and cache a list of todos using useQuery.

terms.definition: A unique array identifying a query, used for caching and deduplication.
The duration data is considered fresh before a background refetch is triggered.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: TanStack Query manages server state outside of React state
Built-in caching, deduplication, and background refetching
Supports mutations, optimistic updates, and pagination
data.takeaway: TanStack Query eliminates the need for manual data fetching and caching logic.
